column77: The rounded points on the axis was too big and could potentially cover up smaller numbers like decimals etc. so harder to get a more fine detailed answer. And also maybe a clearer explanation for the blue buttons at the bottom as it wasn’t as intuitive as the rest of the system

column68: For the questions that asked how confident I was, I preferred it on because it gave me a rough ballpark of what range I could potentially squeeze out of a set amount of fuel. But when it just asked me for a rough estimation I turned it off.
column76: I wasn’t entirely sure if the draggable circles were draggable. There wasn’t much of a clue on screen to imply that they were indeed intractable. I thought that the uncertainty sliders would move the circles dark black circles but then I realised. Once I realised this, I knew from then on how to use the tool so I guess this was a one off struggle. The intuitiveness of having the other circle locked in place when you move one is appreciated as in real life I found that I had inadvertently moved the ruler when I was rotating it.
